## IMessageReportingRule.addToApiReportFile property

Whether to add the message to the API report file. Only applicable when API report generation is enabled.

**Signature:**

```typescript
addToApiReportFile?: boolean;
```

## Remarks

If true and an API report is being generated, the message will be included in the report file instead of being logged to the console.
